HTTP Basic and GET /api/app/me. The guide has no response schema; list_projects returns redacted account metadata without asserting project-field shapes.
Project-scoped Query/Export quotas and ingestion throughput; defaults are a conservative per-runtime approximation.
Batch/event bytes, counts, nested-property limits, strict partial ingestion and Owner/Admin requirement.
Profile ingestion requires a per-project $token; no documented service-account token retrieval workflow. Profile mutations and delete stay out.
The application API server variables document the US/EU/India app origins used for GET /api/app/me. No service-account administration operation is admitted.
